thread: Ember is open. We're a small-batch coffee roaster in Lisbon, and we roast single-origin beans once a week, every Tuesday. Here's what that means and why we built it this way.
One origin per bag. No blends hiding the flavor of a single farm. You taste what the region, altitude and processing actually do to a coffee, and it changes from lot to lot.
We roast every Tuesday in small batches. Beans ship or get bagged within days, so what you open is weeks fresher than most supermarket coffee, which often sits for months.

Subscription starts at 14 euros a month. You choose how often the bag arrives, and you can pause or cancel whenever you want. Each bag comes with a card on the farm, the roast level and how we'd brew it.
The cafe is tiny, on Rua da Rosa in Lisbon. A handful of stools, a short menu, and the same beans we sell by the bag. Come by, taste the current roast, and ask us anything.
That's Ember. Small batches, one origin at a time, roasted every Tuesday. If you want the next roast, the subscription link is in our bio. If you're in Bairro Alto, the door is open.
posts: This week's Tuesday roast is in the cooling tray. Single origin, one farm, one batch. Bagged and labeled by the afternoon.
Why single origin? Because a coffee from one farm tastes like somewhere specific. Blends are consistent. Single origins are interesting. We chose interesting.
Our subscription starts at 14 euros a month. No contract, no minimum. Pause it when you travel, restart when you're back.
The cafe on Rua da Rosa has very few seats and a short menu. That's deliberate. Fewer things, made with more attention.
Brewing tip: weigh your coffee. A cheap kitchen scale does more for your cup than a fancy grinder. Start with 15 grams of coffee to 250 grams of water and adjust from there.
We roast on Tuesdays so freshness is predictable. Coffee tastes best a few days to a few weeks after roasting, and we'd rather you drink it in that window.
data.bio: Small-batch coffee roaster in Lisbon. Single-origin, roasted every Tuesday. Subscriptions from 14 euros a month. Cafe on Rua da Rosa.
